pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: How I Met Your Mother
work.note: How I Met Your Mother é uma série de comédia americana criada por Carter Bays e Craig Thomas e exibida pela rede CBS entre 2005 e 2014. A cena cultural serve de ponte para o foco “entender formas faladas: wanna (want to), gonna (going to) e gotta (have got to)”. A referência mostra conversa informal entre amigos: wanna, gonna, gotta.

pages.title: A city of boxes · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eight in the morning on a cloudy day in Seattle. Ana stands in her empty living room. Boxes cover the floor like a small city. A big truck stops in front of her building. A mover named Dan jumps out with a smile. He knocks on her door.
“Good morning! I’m Dan. Are you ready to move?” says Dan. “Yes. I’ll show you the boxes.” says Ana. “Great. What is in this box?” says Dan.

pages.title: A city of boxes · 3/3
paragraphs: “I’ll hold the door.” says Ana. “Thanks. How long is the drive to your new place?” says Dan. Dan carries box after box to the truck. Ana holds the door for the heavy sofa. They put the fragile box in the front. At noon, they close the truck and drive away. In the new apartment, they carry everything upstairs. A new home starts with a lot of boxes.
